title: Account Executive, Federal - Federal Systems Integrators
location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!
 We are looking for an Account Executive, Federal - Federal Systems Integrators to grow Figma's business across strategic Federal Systems Integrator (FSI) accounts. You will build relationships across the FSI ecosystem, identify where Figma can support large federal programs, and drive complex opportunities from early engagement through close and expansion. You'll own the sales motion - identifying the right programs and buyers, developing opportunities, and driving adoption and revenue.
 This is an opportunity to help shape Figma's FSI business while working across a highly strategic and complex federal market.
 This role is available remotely in the United States.
 What you’ll do at Figma:
 Own and execute account strategies across a portfolio of strategic FSI accounts, building pipeline and consistently achieving revenue targets
 Develop trusted relationships with FSI executives, program and capture teams, technical stakeholders, procurement organizations, and other key decision-makers
 Identify federal programs and initiatives where Figma can play a strategic role, connecting Figma's capabilities to customer mission and business outcomes
 Build strategic account plans that map key stakeholders, programs, agency priorities, funding, contract vehicles, partners, and paths to long-term growth
 Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, engaging customers early to influence requirements, acquisition strategies, and positioning for large federal programs

title: Investment Accounts Associate, Help Desk
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 As an Investment Account Help Desk Associate, you won't be on the front line with customers and instead you'll be the front line for agents who are. You'll serve as the primary escalation path for unlicensed agents, reviewing and resolving escalated tickets that fall outside standard workflows or require deeper product and policy expertise. You'll apply strong judgment to determine the right resolution path, coach agents through complex or ambiguous scenarios, and know when a case needs to go further by working with a licensed, higher-risk, or exception-based partner. You'll also help surface recurring patterns in escalated cases, giving the broader team visibility into where the product, tooling, or support experience needs to evolve. This is an unlicensed role.
 This role is based in our Westlake, TX office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. The team supports customers seven days a week, between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m. ET, and schedules will be assigned based on business needs.
 What you’ll do
 Empower Customer Experience agents by providing timely, empathetic, and accurate guidance via Help Desk tickets and live phone consultations
 Guide Customer Experience agents through complex support workflows, including account activation, login troubleshooting, and funding setup, using approved internal resources
 Support Customer Experience agents in adhering to documented policies and scripts to ensure a consistent high-quality experience for the end customer
 Assist Customer Experience agents in identifying issues that require specialized escalation to licensed teammates or managers, providing clear instructions…

title: Senior Data Analyst
location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 We are seeking a highly skilled and intellectually curious analyst to shape the future of financial data at Instacart, driving innovation at the intersection of systems, analytics, and business strategy.
 In this role, you will architect and deliver data models, pipelines, and reporting infrastructure that empower Finance and Accounting with trusted insights at scale.
 You’ll collaborate across technical and business teams to ensure financial data is accurate, reliable, and compliant, while also advancing large-scale systems initiatives, accelerating the month-end close, and optimizing cloud spend in our AWS environment.
 ABOUT THE TEAM
 The Financial Data Analytics team is the connective tissue between Finance, Accounting, and Engineering. Our mission is to deliver trusted financial data that is both a foundation for compliance and a catalyst…

title: Enterprise Account Executive (London)
description:
About the Company

We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone. 

 

The Role

Aiven is a global technology company providing an open-source data and AI platform across all major clouds. Our platform empowers businesses to stream, store, and analyze data in multi-cloud environments with speed, security, and scalability. As an Enterprise Account Executive for the UKI and BeNeLux region, you will drive strategic growth by acquiring new enterprise customers and expanding relationships within our existing large accounts (>$500M revenue). This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role focused on new logo acquisition, growing usage over baseline, and increasing customer commitments in one of Aiven’s most important markets.

 

In this role, you will engage C-level and senior stakeholders across both technical and business functions (e.g. CTO, CIO, VP Engineering, Head of Product). You’ll leverage Aiven’s proven sales methodologies – MEDDPICC qualification, the Challenger Sales approach, and Command of the Message – to manage complex sales cycles from prospecting to close. If you are a top-performing enterprise SaaS seller with a talent for outcome-based selling and executive engagement, and you’re excited about helping enterprises succeed with cutting-edge open-source data technologies, we want to hear from you.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Drive New Business: Identify, target, and win new enterprise logos in the UKI & BeNeLux region, focusing on organisations with $500M+ in revenue.…
